description: Quality eval set for local_LLM. Deterministic checks only (no judge model needed). Add cases freely; keep checks machine-verifiable.

cases.prompt: Reply with exactly the word PONG and nothing else.
Write one sentence about dogs. Do not use the word 'very' anywhere in your reply.
Reply with ONLY a JSON object (no markdown fences, no prose) describing a book with keys: title, author, year. Use plausible values.
Write a Python function fibonacci(n) that returns the nth Fibonacci number (fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1). Reply with one python code block and nothing else.

Write a Python function is_palindrome(s) that returns True if the string s reads the same forwards and backwards, ignoring case and non-alphanumeric characters. Reply with one python code block and nothing else.

checks.expect: is_palindrome('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama') and not is_palindrome('hello') and is_palindrome('')

cases.prompt: A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 die. How many sheep are left? Reply with just the number.
Reply with exactly 3 words, each starting with the letter B, separated by single spaces. Nothing else.
Explain in one sentence what a hash collision is.
